fun_facts: Tony Pollard is from Memphis, Tennessee.
At Memphis, Tony Pollard played both running back and wide receiver, totaling 2,233 offensive yards and 18 touchdowns.
Tony Pollard averaged 30.1 yards per kickoff return in college and tied an NCAA record with seven kickoff-return touchdowns.
In 2022, Tony Pollard rushed for 1,007 yards and nine touchdowns, averaged 5.2 yards per carry, and earned his first Pro Bowl selection.
Tony Pollard was voted a team captain for the first time in 2025.
